text:
kai: quick question — ran a small spec-decoding proto on the new draft-3-small model. curious if folks have thoughts on eval setup + gotchas.

Daria: nice. what config did you try? top-k speculative? ratio? temp?

kai: 2-stage. speculative actor uses draft-3-small to predict next 8 tokens, verifier is full model. ratio=0.7 (i.e. accept 70% of speculative tokens if verifier agrees), temp=0.7, top_k=40. batching unchanged.

sam: how are you measuring quality? MMLU/PII tests or human eval?

kai: automated runs: MMLU subset, HELM long-form subset, and our page-generation suite (internal prompts). also track perplexity and exact-match where applicable.

Daria: preliminary numbers I saw on a similar setup: ~1.8x tokens/sec improvement, latency P95 down ~35ms, but small drop on few-shot QA EM ~0.6% absolute. hallucination rate on long-form ↑ by ~2–3% (subjective).

miguel: can you paste the run config? I want to reproduce on the rig.

kai: sure — config snippet:
```
model.verifier: redwood-llama-70b
model.speculator: draft-3-small
speculative.max_tokens: 8
speculative.accept_threshold: 0.7
decode.temperature: 0.7
decode.top_k: 40
batching.enabled: true
```

ben: cost reminder — spec decoding shifts cost from verifier to speculator but verifier still needs to run for mismatches. For heavy mismatch workloads the savings evaporate. Have we profiled mismatch % by prompt class?

Daria: yes. mismatch % correlates with open-ended creativity prompts. For deterministic tasks (math, extractive QA) mismatch <10%. For creative rewriting mismatch ~40–50%.

ciara: suggestion: run stratified eval by prompt type and add an automatic fallback policy in Redwood Console: if mismatch rate > X for a route, disable spec. That saves UX surprises.

sam: important eval detail — speculative decoding impacts token-level metrics differently. e.g., BLEU/perplexity can look similar but downstream F1 on span extraction drops. Make sure to include task-specific metrics.

miguel: I'll queue reproducer on the internal rig. @deploy-bot can you spin a job with the above config on "spec-probe-003"?

deploy-bot: queued job 20250312-187 on spec-probe-003, ETA 20m.

Daria: propose next ablations: (1) vary speculator size (small/medium), (2) max_tokens 4/8/16, (3) accept_threshold 0.6/0.7/0.8, (4) temperature alignment between spec and verifier. Capture mismatch% and user-facing hallucination proxy.

kai: also let's capture latency tail per-token vs per-request. spec can reduce avg per-token CPU, but tails can spike on verifier re-rolls.

ben: add cost calc per 1M tokens to ablation table. we'll need to justify in release notes.

ciara: once we have threshold recommendations, I'll draft rollout playbook: canary 1% -> 10% -> 50% with automatic rollback if hallucination proxy up by >1.5x.

sam: one more gotcha — quantized verifier kernels interact with spec when kv cache formats differ. ensure speculator output tokenization matches verifier (BPE/byte offsets).

miguel: noted. i'll validate tokenization and run a unit test that ensures kv cache shapes compatible.

Daria: cool. if the rig run looks like the proto numbers, we can sketch a short tech note: perf vs quality tradeoffs + recommended defaults for different workload classes.

kai: thanks everyone — will post results here in ~40m once the job finishes.

miguel: thanks. ping me if you want me to attach the eval harness dashboards.

ciara: :thumbsup:

kai: (update) job finished — uploading artifacts to /artifacts/spec-probe-003, will break down numbers shortly.
